<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="8J98eGDYCwzxF8AVGPtQ"> <mxGraphModel dx="1414" dy="791" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "classDiagram
 %% Измерения (Dimensions)
 class Dim_User {
 +int UserKey PK
 +string Username
 +string Status
 +string EmailDomain
 }

 class Dim_Server {
 +int ServerKey PK
 +string ServerName
 +string Region
 }

 class Dim_Channel {
 +int ChannelKey PK
 +string ChannelName
 +string ChannelType
 }

 class Dim_Role {
 +int RoleKey PK
 +string RoleName
 +string ColorHex
 }

 class Dim_Date {
 +int DateKey PK
 +date FullDate
 +int Year
 +int Month
 +string DayOfWeek
 }

 class Dim_Time {
 +int TimeKey PK
 +int Hour
 +int Minute
 }

 %% Таблици с факти (Facts)
 class Fact_Messages {
 +int MessageID PK
 +int UserKey FK
 +int ServerKey FK
 +int ChannelKey FK
 +int DateKey FK
 +int TimeKey FK
 +int CharacterCount
 }

 class Fact_RoleAssignments {
 +int AssignmentID PK
 +int UserKey FK
 +int ServerKey FK
 +int RoleKey FK
 +int DateKey FK
 +int AssignmentCount
 }

 class Fact_ServerActivity {
 +int ActivityID PK
 +int ServerKey FK
 +int DateKey FK
 +int ActiveUsersCount
 +int TotalMessagesSent
 }

 %% Връзки към Fact_Messages
 Dim_User \"1\" --> \"*\" Fact_Messages
 Dim_Server \"1\" --> \"*\" Fact_Messages
 Dim_Channel \"1\" --> \"*\" Fact_Messages
 Dim_Date \"1\" --> \"*\" Fact_Messages
 Dim_Time \"1\" --> \"*\" Fact_Messages

 %% Връзки към Fact_RoleAssignments
 Dim_User \"1\" --> \"*\" Fact_RoleAssignments
 Dim_Server \"1\" --> \"*\" Fact_RoleAssignments
 Dim_Role \"1\" --> \"*\" Fact_RoleAssignments
 Dim_Date \"1\" --> \"*\" Fact_RoleAssignments

 %% Връзки към Fact_ServerActivity
 Dim_Server \"1\" --> \"*\" Fact_ServerActivity
 Dim_Date \"1\" --> \"*\" Fact_ServerActivity",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
